description: What CUSTOMERS wrote in the brand's Intercom: reads recent conversations in full and returns only the customers' own words (no teammate or bot text; emails, phone numbers and links redacted; no names). Use it for real pains, objections, questions and exact phrases for ad copy, hooks, angles and research, and quote their words rather than paraphrasing. days (default 30), conversations to read (default 25, at most 60), optional text or tagId to focus it. Read-only, free. Needs Intercom connected (Settings > Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

days.description: look-back window in days for conversations

tagId.description: only read conversations with this Intercom tag id (list_intercom_tags)

text.description: only read conversations containing this text

view.description: conversations to read: open, closed or all

name: intercom_customer_language
title: Customer language from Intercom
